## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
Master-data lookups: `MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE` (a code list, owned by one module through `OWNER_MODULE_CODE`) and
`MDL_LOOKUP_VALUE` (its codes with Arabic and English labels and a sort order), tenant-scoped and copied from
`PLATFORM` at provisioning (ADR-TENANT-009). Users maintain the lists through `/api/v1/mdl/**`; modules read them by
type key through `MdlLookupApi` and store the code.
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
For every status, type, category, unit, reason or other code list a user may maintain. The module seeds its types
and values in a `V1000+` migration (`TENANT_ID = 1`), stores the value's `code` in a `VARCHAR(50)` column,
validates it against `readActiveValuesByKey` at write time and serves its own keys to the UI through
`OwnedLookups` (never a pass-through for arbitrary keys). A `ReportParam.lookup(...)` parameter validates against the
same list.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// read the active options of the module's own type, in MDL's sort order
List<LookupOptionView> statuses = mdlLookupApi.readActiveValuesByKey("SHOP_ORDER_STATUS");

// validate a code before storing it
boolean known = statuses.stream().anyMatch(o -> o.code().equals(request.getStatusCode()));
if (!known) throw new LocalizedException(Status.VALIDATION_ERROR, ShopErrorCodes.ORDER_STATUS_INVALID, request.getStatusCode());

// serve the module's own lookups to the UI, translating MDL's 404 into the module's code
return OwnedLookups.read(key, Set.of("SHOP_ORDER_STATUS", "SHOP_PAYMENT_METHOD"), ShopErrorCodes.LOOKUP_KEY_UNKNOWN,
    k -> mdlLookupApi.readActiveValuesByKey(k).stream().map(mapper::toOption).toList());
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->
